falseSynonyms.zh: 收入不等於 money income 是在一段時間內賺取／收到的錢；money 是更廣的概念。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Income is money received over time.

falseSynonyms.zh: 營業收入不等於一般 money revenue 常指企業／機構營運收入，未扣成本。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Revenue is organisation/business income, not money generally.

falseSynonyms.zh: 利潤不等於 money profit 是收入扣除成本後的餘額。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Profit is what remains after costs.

falseSynonyms.zh: 財富不等於 money wealth 可包括物業、投資及其他資產，不只是現金。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Wealth is a stock of assets.

falseSynonyms.zh: 貨幣不等於所有 money currency 常指貨幣制度、幣種或流通紙幣硬幣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Currency is a monetary unit/system.

falseSynonyms.zh: 預算不等於 money budget 是收入與支出的計劃或限額。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A budget is a plan, not the money itself.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只在投資／營運用途接近 money capital 帶生產、投資或企業用途。
詞性陷阱 money 是名詞；monetary 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Money is a noun; monetary is an adjective.
